Codename - Kids Next Door - Operation -.summary: Codename: Kids Next Door Operation: V.I.D.E.O.G.A.M.E. is a 2005 platformer video game based on the American animated television series Codename: Kids Next Door. It was released for the Nintendo GameCube, Xbox, and PlayStation 2 in North America, Europe, and Australia.
